# GOTC 2026 project starter

Teams can copy this starter into their own repository and replace the placeholders with their project details.

Read [README.md](README.md) for the Chinese project template, setup requirements,
AI-use disclosure, sources, licensing, tests, limitations and submission checklist.

Sign in to the team workbench using your team code. Submit your slides (PPT, PPTX or PDF) and a ZIP containing your complete project. Upload both files or enter accessible HTTPS links. An optional repository version can accompany the submission. For a linked repository, select the option to include its version and check the commit in the preview. Confirm the submission and keep the receipt. Preserve submitted history in any repository you use.

The starter documentation and ignore rules may be reused under
[TEMPLATE-LICENSE.txt](TEMPLATE-LICENSE.txt). Each team must document a license
for its own work and preserve third-party obligations.
